chunks: Ibn Faḍḍāl narrated from Ḥammād al-Laḥḥām, who said:
A caravan passed by Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, and he saw a pack animal that had leaned. So he said: “O boy, adjust this load properly, for Allah, the Exalted, loves justice.”

key_terms.زَامِلَةً: a pack animal carrying a load
key_terms.قِطَارٌ: a caravan or train of riding or pack animals
key_terms.ٱلْحَمْلِ: the load or burden being carried

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith show justice in the treatment of animals and burdens?
ai.summary: This hadith shows Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام instructing that a burden on an animal be balanced properly. It teaches that justice includes fair treatment even in small practical matters, and that Allah the Exalted loves justice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2492 - Ibn Faddal narrated from Hammad al-Lahham, who said:
A caravan passed by Abu Abdullah (as), and he noticed a pack camel that had leaned to one side under its load.
Imam (as) said: "O boy, adjust the load on this animal, for Allah (swt), the Exalted, loves justice."
